deposits; and

implemented?

APTE:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Maharashtra, particularly
the Vidarbha region, Rajasthan and different
parts of Western and Northern India

based appliances

RAO: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
representations seeking reduction in excise
duties on LPG based appliances from 16
per cent to 8 per cent;

duties on such consumer goods are allowing
cheap import destroying thereby the Indian
industry;

rationalize the excise duty structure to

taken to check it;

employees of petrol pumps and the people

extent and there is risk of blood cancer to

(d) if so, the details thereof?

peak hours; and

present status of its implementation?

ground water

the most sought after religious hubs in the
world and the Biju Patnaik Airport
Bhubaneswar fulfils all the requisites of an
international airport;
(b) whether the State Government has
requested for declaring this airport as an
international airport so that it can receive
international flights and also chartered
flights to promote international tourism;
and

proposal and the time-frame within which
it would be sanctioned?

SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any proposal has been
received from Government owned oil

Liquefied Petroleum Gas at unsubsidised

SHRIMATI MOHSINA KIDWAI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:

all Airports in the country for this type of
overhaul?

(c) whether any study has been done

(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

small shareholders

COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether much time is taken in the
